'''Erica Flapan''' (born August 14, 1956) is an American [[mathematician]] and the Lingurn H. Burkhead Professor of Mathematics at [[Pomona College]]. She is a fellow of the [[American Mathematical Society]] and former editor-in-chief of their monthly ''[[Notices of the American Mathematical Society|Notices]]'' journal.<ref>[http://www.math.pomona.edu/faculty.html Faculty listing], Pomona Mathematics Dept., retrieved 2013-01-22.</ref><ref name="about">{{Cite web |title=About ''Notices'' |url=https://www.ams.org/publications/notices/noticesabout |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250209213627/https://www.ams.org/publications/notices/noticesabout |archive-date=9 February 2025 |access-date=2024-12-30 |publisher=American Mathematical Society}}</ref>

==Education and career==
Flapan did her undergraduate studies at [[Hamilton College (New York)|Hamilton College]], graduating in 1977,<ref name="cv"/><ref name="jmm11"/> and went on to graduate studies at the [[University of Wisconsin–Madison]], earning a Ph.D. in 1983 under the supervision of Daniel McMillan.<ref>{{mathgenealogy|id=9768}}</ref>

After postdoctoral studies at [[Rice University]] and the [[University of California, Santa Barbara]] she joined the Pomona faculty in 1986.<ref name="cv">[http://pages.pomona.edu/~elf04747/EF.vita.pdf Curriculum vitae], retrieved 2013-01-22.</ref><ref name="jmm11"/> Flapan's research is in [[low-dimensional topology]] and [[knot theory]].

==Books==
Flapan is the author or coauthor of books including:
*''[[When Topology Meets Chemistry|When Topology Meets Chemistry: A Topological Look at Molecular Chirality]]'' (Cambridge University Press and Mathematical Association of America, 2000)<ref>Reviews of ''When Topology Meets Chemistry'':
*{{citation|last=Langton|first=Stacy G.|date=January 2001|journal=MAA Reviews|publisher=[[Mathematical Association of America]]|title=Review|url=https://www.maa.org/press/maa-reviews/when-topology-meets-chemistry-a-topological-look-at-molecular-chirality}}
*{{citation|last=van Rensburg|first=Buks|date=May–June 2001|issue=3|journal=[[American Scientist]]|jstor=27857483|pages=279–280|title=Untangling molecular knots|volume=89}}
*{{citation|last=Whittington|first=Stuart|date=September 2001|issue=3|journal=[[SIAM Review]]|jstor=3649818|pages=577–579|title=none|volume=43}}
*{{citation|last=Lord|first=Nick|date=November 2001|doi=10.2307/3621805|issue=504|journal=The Mathematical Gazette|jstor=3621805|pages=550–552|title=none|volume=85}}
*{{citation|last=Keesling|first=J. E.|journal=[[Mathematical Reviews]]|mr=1781912|title=none|year=2002}}
*{{citation|last=Ashbacher|first=Charles|issue=1|journal=[[Journal of Recreational Mathematics]]|title=Review|volume=34|year=2005–2006|id={{ProQuest|89066158}}}}</ref>
*''Number Theory: A Lively Introduction with Proofs, Applications, and Stories'' (with James Pommersheim and Tim Marks, John Wiley & Sons, 2010)<ref>Review of ''Number Theory: A Lively Introduction'':
*{{citation|last=Bóna|first=Miklós|date=April 2010|journal=MAA Reviews|publisher=[[Mathematical Association of America]]|title=Review|url=https://www.maa.org/press/maa-reviews/number-theory-a-lively-introduction-with-proofs-applications-and-stories}}</ref>
*''Knots, Molecules, and the Universe: An Introduction to Topology'' (2015)<ref>Reviews of ''Knots, Molecules, and the Universe'':
*{{citation|last=Adams|first=Colin C.|journal=[[Mathematical Reviews]]|mr=3443369|title=none}}
*{{citation|last=Ernst|first=Claus|journal=[[zbMATH]]|title=none|zbl=1343.57001}}
*{{citation|last=Schulte|first=Tom|date=April 2016|journal=MAA Reviews|publisher=[[Mathematical Association of America]]|title=Review|url=https://www.maa.org/press/maa-reviews/knots-molecules-and-the-universe-an-introduction-to-topology}}
*{{citation|last=Kidwell|first=Mark|date=October 2016|doi=10.4169/amer.math.monthly.123.8.840|issue=8|journal=[[American Mathematical Monthly]]|jstor=10.4169/amer.math.monthly.123.8.840|pages=840–843|title=none|volume=123}}</ref>

Her [[edited volume]]s include ''Applications of Knot Theory'' (with Dorothy Buck, 2009), ''Knots, Links, Spatial Graphs, and Algebraic Invariants'' (with [[Allison Henrich]], Aaron Kaestner, and Sam Nelson, 2017), and ''Topology and Geometry of Biopolymers'' (with Helen Wong, 2018).

==Recognition==
In 2011, Flapan was one of three winners of the  [[Deborah and Franklin Haimo Awards for Distinguished College or University Teaching of Mathematics|Deborah and Franklin Haimo Award for Distinguished College or University Teaching of Mathematics]], from the [[Mathematical Association of America]].<ref name="jmm11">Award citation, [http://www.maa.org/awards/jmm11PB.pdf January 2011 Prizes and Awards], MAA, retrieved 2013-01-22.</ref><ref>[http://www.maa.org/awards/Haimo_Recipients.html Halmo award recipients] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20070930023826/http://www.maa.org/awards/Haimo_Recipients.html |date=2007-09-30 }}, MAA, retrieved 2013-01-22.</ref> In 2012 she became a fellow of the [[American Mathematical Society]],<ref>[https://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list List of Fellows of the American Mathematical Society], retrieved 2013-01-21.</ref> and in the same year as part of the bicentennial of Hamilton College was honored with a Hamilton Alumni Achievement Medal.<ref>[http://www.hamilton.edu/news/archive/science-center/science-symposium Hamilton Alumni Achievement Medals] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140905110712/http://www.hamilton.edu/news/archive/science-center/science-symposium |date=2014-09-05 }}, Hamilton College, retrieved 2013-01-22.</ref> In recognition of her devotion to mentoring, Flapan won the [[M. Gweneth Humphreys Award]] from the [[Association for Women in Mathematics]] in 2018.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://awm-math.org/awards/humphreys-award/humphreys-award-2018/|title=Humphreys Award 2018|website=Association for Women in Mathematics (AWM)|language=en-US|access-date=2019-11-05}}</ref> She delivered the Chan Stanek Lecture for Students at [[MathFest]] 2021.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Invited Addresses {{!}} Mathematical Association of America|url=https://www.maa.org/node/2567109/|access-date=2021-06-04|website=www.maa.org|archive-date=2021-06-04|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210604105237/https://www.maa.org/node/2567109/|url-status=dead}}</ref>
